neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Protected peaceful assembly and actual protest coexist with arrests, force and road/public-order restrictions. Mixed response weighs these competing implementations; exact emergency-access-only rule was not found.

Educated assumption: Constitutional criticism/expression coexist with criminal/cybercrime and regional blasphemy restrictions. Mixed response reflects lawful criticism plus punishment of some offensive expression, not automatic uncertainty.

Educated assumption: Constitutional court safeguards and ECOWAS2026judicial-review order oppose unchecked detention, while prolonged security detention and institutional noncompliance persist. Mixed answer reflects contrary law/practice; exact terrorism-specific exceptions remain unverified.

Educated assumption: Constitutional promotion of Nigerian cultures is plural while national heritage projects remain common. Mixed response weighs predominant national projects and distinct community traditions; exact funding distribution is unmeasured.

Educated assumption: Regional mobility and varied residence routes coexist with investor/skill and authorization requirements. Mixed answer weighs genuine settlement access and selective conditions, not universal permission.

Educated assumption: Recognized refugee health/education/work and integration access coexist with narrowly targeted national cash schemes and no proved broad noncitizen rental entitlement. Mixed response reflects programme/status differences; asylum applicants lack explicit work permits.

Educated assumption: Regional/protection inclusion and selective investor/skill routes coexist without a verified diversity-for-its-own-sake admissions target. Mixed response weighs plural inclusion against instrumental selection; exact cultural-diversity directive was not found.

Educated assumption: Regional dialogue and deescalation coexist with sovereignty/security red lines and military resolve. Mixed response weighs concessions and retained security aims; exact substantial-position weakening bargain was not established.

Educated assumption: Regional force readiness can back diplomacy while current national statement stresses dialogue. Mixed response weighs credible force and diplomatic priority; old2023Niger threat is not a current2026war.

Educated assumption: Constitutional supremacy/treaty enactment coexist with binding regional human-rights jurisdiction. Mixed response reflects overlapping authorities and noncompliance concerns; precise every conflict precedence case was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Regional environmental cooperation and shared problems coexist with domestic statutory authority. Mixed response distinguishes coordination from broad delegated environmental decision power; precise2026pooled authority was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National immigration control coexists with ECOWASmobility and international protection obligations. Mixed response reflects real regional constraints without assuming joint border administration everywhere.

Educated assumption: Public strategic companies/development banking coexist with privatization of competitive enterprises. Mixed response weighs real establishment/retention and private-sector preference, not all industries state-owned.

Educated assumption: Public hospitals coexist with significant private healthcare provision. Mixed answer concerns facility title rather than public finance alone; precise nationwide ownership shares were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: State-owned NNPCLcoexists with private resource extraction/operators. Mixed response reflects title by sector; public ownership of resources alone is not ownership of every extraction firm.

Educated assumption: Regional integration and reforms coexist with tariffs/import restrictions. Mixed response weighs actual liberalization and retained barriers rather than assuming unconditional removal.

Educated assumption: Private international purchasing and regional trade coexist with prohibited/restricted goods and foreign-exchange conditions. Mixed response weighs ordinary choice against source/product controls; every origin rule was not consolidated.
Educated assumption: Fuel price liberalization coexists with regulated/subsidized utility pricing. Mixed response reflects actual sector differences, not uniform essential-goods control.

Educated assumption: Private crypto/stablecoin use coexists with sovereign naira legal tender and regulatory controls. Mixed response reflects limited competing payment practice without proving universal private legal-tender parity.

Educated assumption: Targeted poverty relief and progressive tax coexist with investment/earnings incentives. Mixed response reflects redistribution plus restraint rather than an absolute equality-only taxation justification.

Educated assumption: Tax reforms include relief and revenue raising while targeted transfers expand. Mixed response weighs both rather than treating the president’s future support promise as fully delivered.

Educated assumption: Major emergency cash targets vulnerability/basic needs while contributory pensions and other payments reach beyond current destitution. Mixed response reflects eligibility differences; exact full2026cash programme inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: National civil law/no official religion coexist with constitutionally recognized Sharia jurisdiction and regional religious criminal rules. Mixed response distinguishes national legal framework and regional religious sources; no single official national faith is inferred.

Educated assumption: Civil courts/statutes coexist with constitutionally binding Sharia personal-law courts and regional religious rulings. Mixed response reflects distinct jurisdictions rather than all courts issuing clerical rulings.

Educated assumption: Constitutional no official religion coexists with public religious institutions/multi-faith symbolism. Mixed response reflects varied buildings; exact national building-symbol inventory was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Civil marriage pathways coexist with binding religious family law. Mixed response weighs civil choice and retained religious requirements; precise all current marriage categories were not consolidated.

Educated assumption: Equality/education interventions challenge gender barriers while regional family/moral rules preserve distinct roles. Mixed response reflects institutional variation; citizen attitudes are not substituted.

Educated assumption: Constitutional nondiscrimination/education equality coexist with role expectations and regional enforcement. Mixed response concerns institutions, not claiming all citizens equally accept nontraditional gender roles.
Educated assumption: AIdeployment beyond small trials coexists with medical/GMOstaged testing. Mixed response reflects sector thresholds rather than blanket all-tech confinement.

Educated assumption: Environmental assessment duties coexist with infrastructure expansion and imperfect enforcement. Mixed response weighs precaution and timely development; exact every uncertainty-triggered delay rule was not found.

Educated assumption: Federal supremacy/exclusive powers coexist with protected state powers and judicial jurisdiction resolution. Mixed response distinguishes defined competence from unlimited executive final say; every2026conflict case was not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Federal insurance/health frameworks coexist with state public facilities and programmes. Mixed response reflects shared authority, not all national or all regional treatment control; precise full benefit schedules were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Violence/stress surroundings and nutrition/health vulnerability coexist with individual biological susceptibility. Mixed interaction is likeliest, not a documented national genetic/environment share.

Educated assumption: Early learning environments and nutrition/health/neurodevelopment both affect attention. Mixed interaction is likeliest; exact ordinary attention genetic/environment shares are not measured by the source.

Educated assumption: Caregiving/social environment and health/biological individual variation coexist in development. Mixed temperament interaction is likeliest; source does not quantify inherited predominance.
